data.description:
🌴👋 Ahoy!
Here is the scoop on our 62ft Boat in San Diego...

⏱️ DURATION:
2 hours MIN (3-4 hours BEST)

🛥️ THE BOAT:
1️⃣ 62ft “SUNSET DUO” (Up to 13 max)
💰 $700/hr (Split w/ 13 = ~$54/hr per person!)
📸 Photos:  https://www.icloud.com/sharedalbum/#B2TG6Mn98059lc

✅ EVERYTHING INCLUDED:
👨‍✈️ Captain, ⛽️ Fuel, 💃Dance Floor, 🎤 Karaoke, 🏈 LIVE Sports, 🎶 Music, 📺 TVs, 🍩Floaty! NO hidden fees.

🌮 THE TACOS & TEQUILA PLAN:
We are BYOB & BYOF. Don't pay $20 per margarita. Bring your own Tacos, a bottle of Tequila, and throw a legendary fiesta on the water! 🍹🥑

👇 READY TO CHECK DATES?
Tap the link below to see 📸 photos, ⭐️ reviews, and 🔒 LOCK IN your spot!

🤗WHAT’S INCLUDED:
1. Yacht rental
2. USCG Captain
3. Deckhand
4. Fuel
5. Insurance
6. Port fees
7. WiFi
8. (2) TVs
9. Karaoke
10. Large Kitchen & Bathroom

15. Cups
16. TIKI Mugs
17. Straws
18. Plates
19. Utensils
20. Napkins
21. Shot Glasses & Cocktail Shakers
22. 💦HUGE Floating Lilly Pad🛟
23. 🧊HUGE Ice Chest
24. Bluetooth Speakers

🤗WHAT TO BRING:
- Food & Snacks
- Alcoholic Beverages
- Bag of Ice
- Warm Layers
- Towel
- Swimsuit

🛥️💦🎶🎤ACTIVITIES & TOURS:
CHOOSE your Adventure or POINT & GO!

1. (2 HRS)
🛥🥂Cruise San Diego Bay, Tour Downtown & Embarcadero Park, Get up-close w/ USS Midway, See Shell Amphitheater & Pass by 🌉Coronado Bridge!

2. (3-4 HRS)
🛥🥂Bay Cruise + ⚓Anchor @ 🏝Glorietta Bay Coronado, 🥳Party @ Sea & 👙Swim!

While cruising OR at ⚓:
😎LAY out
🍹SHAKE cocktails
♨️GRILL out
🎤🎶SING karaoke
💃VIBE on dance floor
🏀WATCH sports
🌇ENJOY Views
DURING cruise we often see 🦭 Sea Lions & sometimes 🐬or🐳

🥂✨ Ready to reserve your cruise?

data.booking_notes:
🌴💦 Ahoy Island Cruiser!
We are thrilled to have you and your guests onboard soon!

#⚠️**3 REQUIRED STEPS TO FINALIZE YOUR BOOKING**⚠️

**1.** **[CLICK HERE NOW to eSign your CHARTER AGREEMENT](https://app.hellosign.com/s/5DCtzy14).**

**2.** **TEXT YOUR PHOTO ID** to us at 310-906-0092.

**3.** **GROUP TEXT** this **PASSENGER WAIVER link** to your guests **NOW**. ALL GUESTS are REQUIRED to ESIGN WAIVER in order to board. ALL GUESTS please have your PASSENGER WAIVER confirmation email OPEN & READY TO SHOW our Crew before your departure time to avoid any delays.**🐳

👉**[Click Here to eSign your “Passenger Waiver”](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/637d44bedacbc/web/).**

🌴🌴🌴**Below is your Checklist of 17 FAQs for a smooth cruise!**🌴🌴🌴

🤔**What To Bring?**
1. 🧥***WARM CLOTHING*** layers.
2. ***TOWEL***.
3. 👙***SWIM SUIT***.
4. 🍕🍹***FOOD, ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES and 🧊ICE***. (NO RED Drinks, RED Cake or RED Curry)
5. 💵Please bring ***CASH GRATUITY*** as it is not included, *we suggest 15-20% for excellent service as it’s industry standard. You can also pay by Venmo, cash app or Zelle.If you tipped on a card, please disregard as the crew saw it! 🤗

🤔**What Shoes Should I Wear?**
·        NO Shoes are allowed onboard. To protect the boat from damage and dirt please remove and stow your shoes once onboard. We recommend bringing socks if your feet get cold.

🤔**Where Do I Meet the Island Boat SD?**
·        H&M LANDING located at ***2803 Emerson St, San Diego, Ca 92016*** next to Point Loma Seafoods. Please gather and wait at the ***H&M Landing DOCK GATE*** until your Captain and Crew come get you for Island Boat SD.

![DOCK BUILDING](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/J9eckDqRQC6Exu66BGrw)

![DOCK GATE](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/OSCHYXGTSjOeVtPq6M61)

🤔**What Time Should I Arrive?**
·       We recommend arriving ***30 minutes EARLY***. The ***Captain will CALL & MEET you at the DOCK GATE when your boat is DOCKED & READY to board***. There may be another party disembarking, so we appreciate your patience while our crew cleans thoroughly before boarding. We will board once your entire party arrives and the boat is ready. IF the boat and crew is running LATE, rest assured you will get your full time.

🤔**What About Parking?**
·        There are parking lots located at and around ***2803 Emerson St, San Diego, CA  92106***. The H&M Landing parking lot can be very busy, so cruise around in the RED mapped area. You can unload your stuff at the round-a-bout in front of H&M first.
![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/twEGd7hdScnNN57VWbSw)

🤔**What If My Party Is Late?**
·       Your cruise time **BEGINS** and **ENDS** according to your booking itinerary… not when you arrive. The Dock requires us to depart within 15 minutes from your scheduled Departure Time. **If you are going to be 15 minutes late please Text or Call us at (310) 906-0092.**

🤔**Can We Extend Our Cruise?**
·        Text or Call us at (310) 906-0092 OR let the Captain or Crew know and we will see if that can be arranged based upon availability of the vessel. The cost will be based on your booked hourly rate.

🤔**Can We Bring Alcohol Aboard Island Boat SD?**
·        It would be weird if you didn't. As long as guests are over 21, you are welcome to bring and drink whatever you like. *Please NO Red wine, NO glass beer bottles allowed.*

🤔**Can We Board Early to 🎈🎉Decorate?**
·         Any decorating and clean up of decorations must be done during your scheduled rental time. We recommend keeping it minimal (a sign and a numbered balloon or two) since the boat is already decorated or booking more time to allow for your decorating.

🤔**Is Island Boat SD Kid-Friendly?**
·        Absolutely, guests of all ages are welcome. If anyone has a tendency to get motion sick or sea sick, please be sure to take something ahead of time.

🤔**Is Island Boat SD Dog-Friendly?**
·        While we love our pups, it is not appropriate to have them aboard while underway for safety and cleanliness. Out of respect to ALL guests, we ask that you leave your furry friend at home, ESA's included.

🤔**Can We Smoke Aboard Island Boat SD?**
·        NO. Just below your seats are 480 gallons of fuel, plus we want to keep the boat nice for a long time to come, and burn holes are hard to repair. ***You may vape responsibly.***

🤔**What About Weed, Man?**
·        Since we will be on federal waters and marijuana is not federally legal, that's a big NO. You can leave the drugs at home... you're going to have a great time without them.
*FYI… The Coast Guard does random safety checks and can board us at anytime.*

🤔**How Many People Can We Have In Our Group?**
·        13 Max as per US Coast Guard and Port of San Diego regulations. The USCG strictly prohibits us from carrying more than 13 guests.

🤔**What Activities & Tours Are There?**
·        A USCG Licensed Captain and Deckhand will be taking care of you and your guests. You can instruct them as to what route you would prefer to take and get recommendations based upon your cruise time for what you’d like to see and do.
·        Cruise San Diego Bay!
·        Tour Downtown San Diego & Embarcadero Park, USS Midway, Rady Shell Amphitheater, & Pass through the arches of the Coronado Bridge!
·        Drop Anchor at Glorietta Bay, Party at Sea & Swim!
·        And of course at anytime… Dance, Karaoke, Lay out, Watch for Seals/Dolphins/Whales, Shake Cocktails, Eat Charcuterie & Enjoy the Downtown San Diego Skyline and Coastal Scene!

🤔**Excessive Messes & Toilets?**
·        ***There is a $250 cleaning fee for excessive messes or clogged toilets.*** Boat Plumbing is EXTREMELY SENSITIVE. Please discard all toilet paper, tissues and tampons in the bathroom trash can. Do not worry… there is a SIGN inside the bathroom as a reminder for you and your guests. Our crew will also remind you during the boarding safety brief.

🤔**Cancellation Policy?**
Cancellations ***more than*** 30 days from departure date, 100% refunded of Total Rental. Cancellations ***less than*** 30 days from departure date, no refunds. If a charter is canceled due to unsafe weather, 100% refunded or Charterer may reschedule.

**If you have any questions don't hesitate to Call/Text us at (310) 906-0092 or email us at IslandBoatSD@gmail.com.**

Happy Cruising! 🥂
